_about: Asaptic public proof manifest. Every claim below is falsifiable against a live URL with a single command. Artifact-transparent only: it pins the shape and integrity of the public tender feed and the addresses of the public endpoints. It reveals nothing about corpus size, per-market counts, pipeline cadence, or any non-public detail. States are honest: an endpoint is marked live only when a probe returned parseable JSON; endpoints still shipping are marked pending_rollout.

tender_feed.probe: GET returns application/json parseable as asaptic.tender.v1 envelope

tenders_api.probe: GET currently resolves to the site shell (text/html), not the JSON listing API; not yet deployed

health.probe: GET currently resolves to the site shell (text/html); health endpoint not yet deployed

schema.sha256_basis: JSON Schema 2020-12 contract document, hashed 2026-08-10 from the developers-surface branch. Once that branch is published this digest will match: curl -s https://asaptic.com/developers/contract/asaptic.tender.v1.schema.json | shasum -a 256

snapshot.sha256_basis: sha256 of the decoded response body of the live public feed at verification time. Reproduce: curl -s --compressed https://asaptic.com/tender/rows.json | shasum -a 256
snapshot.note: Volatile: the feed republishes and this digest rotates each issue. To falsify against this manifest, compare only while issue_id is 2026-W33; a changed digest under a new issue_id is expected, not a fault.

conformance.note: The live feed snapshot above validates against the pinned schema: all required envelope keys present, and every published row carries the 11 contract fields with a conforming id and a 64-hex sort key. Falsify by validating the snapshot body against the schema url above.
